newsitem.title: USA: Badger Paper Mills holders reject investor effort.
newsitem.headline: Badger Paper Mills holders reject investor effort.

text.p: Badger Paper Mills Inc said Thursday its shareholders rejected an effort by a large stockholder seeking to increase its stake in the company to more than 20 percent from 14.2 percent.

The company said a recent vote by shareholders indicated that 72 percent supported management's call to reject the effort by a group led by investor James Azzar. The group had said it wanted to encourage Badger's board to consider measures to increase shareholder value, including a possible sale by the company of its assets.
Badger is an integrated paper products manufacturer.
